gen-fs-bonny-fs-hind: Hind runs on lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals, with string-like strokes and c endings that never curl inward. Bonny brings literary refinement; Hind brings steady, workmanlike sans clarity.
gen-fs-bonny-inter: Refined Bonny leads with a mid-range stroke contrast and gaping curves, tight-set and literary. Inter then runs smooth as a tube, its big counters keeping a full page of text open and unhurried.
gen-fs-bonny-montserrat: Approachable Montserrat glides under the eye, with oversized counters and generous white space before each curve. And Bonny earns its keep big and brief, where its mellow thick-thin shifts and literary air can show.
gen-fs-bonny-roboto-slab: Bonny sets a literary, refined tone with tight lines and gaping curves. Its subtle thick-thin modulation does the refined talking, while Roboto Slab, a slab-serif, brings a dominant middle zone and open throats.
gen-fs-boxing-fs-bespoke-sans: Boxing is energetic and bold, with a wire-bent look across each word. It earns its keep big and short, while Bespoke Sans, sharp and refined, is made for brief bursts of reading.
gen-fs-boxing-fs-roundo: Generous sidebearings and wide channels into every bowl give Boxing its bold, energetic stance. Roundo handles the quiet part, its n arch matching the stem, with unclogged counters suited to a brief stretch of text.
gen-fs-britney-cabin: Britney is a relaxed, expressive calligraphic hand with very narrow room around each letter. And Cabin, warm sans-serif tubing with open terminals, wants some extra size, since this pair is best with little text.
gen-fs-britney-fs-bespoke-sans: Britney is expressive, a calligraphic hand with tight spacing. Its best trick is a stroke that never thins, met by Bespoke Sans, a sharp sans-serif with open curve ends, made for brief reading.
gen-fs-britney-fs-literata: Relaxed Britney writes in a plain, unshaded line that never swells. Britney does the expressive work; Literata, a bookish serif with strokes that differ just enough, takes the reading, though not dense pages.
gen-fs-britney-fs-synonym: Britney writes in a calligraphic hand, relaxed and expressive, with narrow letter room. Synonym, a dependable sans-serif with open curves, steps in as a plain stripe of ink behind the script, though dense text is not the aim.
